title: Predicting Primary Refractory Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma: A Comparison of Machine Learning Models with the IPI Score.
summary: Machine-learning models estimated primary refractory DLBCL in 369 retrospective single-center patients, with IPI strongest on the 73-patient holdout and gradient boosting best among ML models; ML did not outperform IPI. The result is a disease-specific prognostic comparison, and authors call for external validation.
